PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Server list sorted by player count, without pinned "recommended" servers
PluginData.Description:
Makes the server list in Join Game fair to every server.
- Keen's "recommended" servers are no longer pinned to the top of the list. - The star marks your favorite servers instead. Right click a server to add it to your favorites or remove it, on any tab. - Favorite servers that move to a new address are recognized by their server and world name. - The list is sorted by player count by default, busiest first. - Click any column header to sort by it instead, as before. All the vanilla filters work as before.
Report bugs on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-fair-server-list/issues
